scenario.topic: Choose a seating and attendance policy for hybrid lectures

options.name: Assigned Seating with Mandatory In-Person Attendance
options.upside: Ensures consistent seating and full in-person engagement.
options.concern: Excludes remote participants and reduces flexibility.

options.name: Flexible Seating with Optional Remote Attendance
options.upside: Offers maximum flexibility for all participants.
options.concern: May cause unpredictable seating and variable in-person presence.

options.name: Rotating Assigned Seating with Hybrid Attendance Requirement
options.upside: Balances in-person and remote participation fairly.
options.concern: Requires coordination and may complicate scheduling.

options.name: Open Seating with Mandatory Weekly In-Person Session

attrs.attendance_mode: remote allowed except one weekly in-person

options.upside: Supports remote flexibility while maintaining some in-person interaction.
options.concern: May reduce continuity in seating and group cohesion.

shared_context: The group must decide on a seating and attendance policy for hybrid lectures involving 7 participants. The policy should accommodate both in-person and remote attendance while ensuring clear guidelines on seating arrangements and participation requirements.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a graduate student who values group interaction and flexibility.
personas.private_goal: Ensure some in-person interaction while allowing remote attendance.

A.reason_for: Ensures consistent seating and full engagement, which can improve group dynamics.
A.reason_against: Excludes remote participants, reducing flexibility Maya values.

B.reason_for: Offers maximum flexibility, supporting remote attendance.
B.reason_against: Unpredictable seating may reduce group cohesion.

C.reason_for: Balances in-person and remote fairly, supporting hybrid needs.
C.reason_against: Requires coordination which may complicate scheduling.

D.reason_for: Supports remote flexibility while maintaining mandatory weekly in-person sessions, fitting Maya's goals.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a part-time worker attending lectures who prefers flexibility.
personas.private_goal: Attend lectures remotely when work schedule conflicts.

A.reason_for: Ensures engagement when in-person, but not useful for Liam's need for remote.
A.reason_against: Mandatory in-person excludes remote attendance, which Liam needs.

B.reason_for: Allows remote attendance anytime, fitting Liam's work constraints.

C.reason_for: Hybrid attendance allows some remote participation, but requires scheduling effort.

D.reason_for: Allows remote attendance except one mandatory session, balancing flexibility and in-person needs.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a senior lecturer who values structure and clear rules.
personas.private_goal: Maintain strict attendance and seating for order and accountability.

A.reason_for: Ensures consistent seating and full in-person engagement, matching Zoe's preference for order.

B.reason_for: Offers flexibility but lacks the strict structure Zoe prefers.
B.reason_against: Unpredictable seating and variable presence reduce accountability.

C.reason_for: Balances hybrid attendance with assigned seating, providing some structure.
C.reason_against: Coordination complexity is a downside but acceptable.

D.reason_for: Supports some in-person interaction but open seating reduces continuity Zoe prefers.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a tech enthusiast who values fairness and balanced participation.
personas.private_goal: Ensure equal opportunity for remote and in-person attendance.

A.reason_for: Strong engagement in-person but excludes remote, which Eli finds unfair.

B.reason_for: Flexible attendance suits Eli's preference for choice.
B.reason_against: Unpredictable seating may reduce fairness in participation.

C.reason_for: Rotating assigned seating with hybrid attendance balances fairness and participation.

D.reason_for: Allows remote attendance except mandatory session, but open seating less structured.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a working professional who values convenience and flexibility.
personas.private_goal: Maximize ability to attend remotely without strict seating rules.

A.reason_for: Ensures engagement but excludes remote, which Nina cannot accept.

B.reason_for: Maximum flexibility and remote participation fit Nina's lifestyle.

C.reason_for: Hybrid attendance is acceptable but less convenient than full flexibility.

D.reason_for: Supports remote flexibility with some in-person interaction.
D.reason_against: Open seating and mandatory session may reduce convenience.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a graduate researcher who prefers predictable schedules and fairness.
personas.private_goal: Have clear attendance rules that balance remote and in-person fairly.

A.reason_for: Clear rules and fixed seating but excludes remote, limiting Omar's flexibility.

B.reason_against: Unpredictable seating reduces predictability Omar prefers.

C.reason_for: Rotating assigned seating with hybrid attendance balances fairness and predictability.

D.reason_for: Allows remote attendance except mandatory session but open seating less predictable.

personas.name: Tara
personas.background: Tara is an undergraduate student who values directness and flexibility.
personas.private_goal: Attend lectures remotely when needed without complicated rules.

A.reason_for: Strong engagement but inflexible and excludes remote attendance.
A.reason_against: Mandatory in-person attendance conflicts with Tara's need for flexibility.

B.reason_for: Maximum flexibility and remote attendance anytime fit Tara's needs.

C.reason_for: Hybrid attendance is acceptable but adds complexity.

D.reason_for: Supports remote flexibility with some in-person interaction.
D.reason_against: Open seating and mandatory session may reduce simplicity Tara prefers.
